source_title: Reusable evaluators and evaluator template library in LangSmith
claim_summary: Vendor post says LangSmith now includes 30+ evaluator templates (safety/security incl. prompt-injection and PII checks; response quality; trajectory; user behavior; multimodal) plus reusable evaluators; templates also shipped in openevals v0.2.0 the same day
availability: vendor states available now; spend visibility for evaluations listed as coming next
limitation: No independent measurement of evaluator validity or agreement with human graders; LLM-judge templates are not independent acceptance tests

source_title: Running subagents in the background (async subagents)
claim_summary: Vendor says async subagents shipped to Deep Agents: supervisor receives a task ID and can keep working and steer; built on Agent Protocol, a framework-agnostic API for threads/runs/status; runs on LangSmith deployments or self-hosted
availability: shipped per vendor; no version number stated
limitation: No version pinned on page; no independent reliability or failure-handling test of long-running background tasks

source_title: HTMLHeaderTextSplitter.split_text_from_url SSRF Redirect Bypass (CVE-2026-41481)
claim_summary: Medium-severity SSRF redirect bypass in HTMLHeaderTextSplitter.split_text_from_url; advisory lists langchain-text-splitters below 1.1.2 as affected and 1.1.2 as patched
availability: patched release 1.1.2 listed
limitation: Severity is advisory-assigned; no prevalence or exploitation data; affects only callers fetching untrusted URLs

source_title: Unsafe deserialization of attacker-controlled LangChain objects through overly broad load() allowlists (CVE-2026-44843)
claim_summary: High-severity advisory: some runtime paths called load() with overly broad allowlists so attacker-crafted constructor dicts could instantiate trusted LangChain classes; affected langchain-core 1.0 to 1.3.2 and up to 0.3.84; patched 1.3.3 and 0.3.85
limitation: OSV lists publication 2026-05-26 vs GitHub advisory 2026-05-05 (date discrepancy); no exploitation evidence; OSV is a database mirror, not an independent audit

source_title: langgraph 1.2.0 GitHub release
claim_summary: Release notes list durable error-handler resume across host crashes, StateGraph set_node_defaults(), forced delta-channel snapshot after max supersteps, and mark DeltaChannel/delta-history APIs as beta; checkpoint 4.1.0 and checkpoint-postgres/sqlite 3.1.0 released the same day
availability: stable release; delta-channel APIs beta
limitation: Release-note bullets only; durability claims not independently exercised; checkpoint 4.1.0 later affected by GHSA-fjqc-hq36-qh5p

source_title: Introducing LangSmith Engine
claim_summary: Vendor describes an autonomous system that watches production traces, clusters failures into named issues, diagnoses root causes against a connected repo and can open a PR, create an online evaluator or add failing traces to an offline dataset
feature: trace-driven issue detection and fix proposals
availability: public beta; no plan/pricing stated on page
limitation: No independent precision/recall of issue detection or accepted-fix rate; proposed PRs still need human review

source_title: LangSmith Sandboxes are Generally Available
claim_summary: Vendor says sandboxes are microVMs kernel-isolated from customer services and each other; outbound Auth Proxy injects credentials at network layer so secrets do not reach runtime; creator-private by default with domain allow/deny lists; CLI supports ssh/scp/rsync/sftp
availability: GA per vendor; regions and pricing not stated on page
limitation: No independent isolation/security audit located; related-content cards on page show later dates (page not archived)

source_title: Introducing Managed Deep Agents
claim_summary: Vendor announces an API-first hosted runtime for deep agents built on the open-source harness: durable threads, streaming runs, checkpointing, human-in-the-loop, Context Hub memory, versioned AGENTS.md/skills/subagents/tools.json, automatic tracing
availability: body says private beta; a later update note on the same page says public beta
limitation: Page was edited after publication (update note); original wording not archived; hosted service is proprietary

product: Interrupt 2026 launches (LLM Gateway; SmithDB; Context Hub; Fleet Sandboxes; Deep Agents 0.6)
source_title: Interrupt 2026 overview
claim_summary: Vendor roundup of Interrupt 2026 (held May 13-14 per vendor preview post): Engine public beta, Sandboxes GA, LLM Gateway private beta, Fleet Sandboxes public beta, SmithDB backing core LangSmith workloads, Context Hub, Deep Agents 0.6
availability: mixed: GA / public beta / private beta / unlabeled
limitation: Roundup mixes availability classes; independent news item is a secondary relay of vendor claims with no third-party testing

source_title: Introducing LangChain Labs
claim_summary: CEO post announces an applied research effort on continual learning from traces, feedback and eval results, with partners Harvey, NVIDIA, Prime Intellect, Fireworks and Baseten; promises to publish research, evals and open-source integrations
availability: announced intention; no artifact dated in post
limitation: Stated intentions only; partner roles not verified with partners

source_title: Unsafe JSON deserialization in LangGraph checkpoint loading (CVE-2026-48775)
claim_summary: Medium-severity advisory: JsonPlusSerializer could reconstruct arbitrary objects from tampered checkpoint data; langgraph-checkpoint up to 4.1.0 affected, 4.1.1 patched; Wiz entry lists CVSS 6.8, requires write access to checkpoint store, reporter from CyStack
availability: patched 4.1.1
limitation: Exploitation requires write access to persistence layer; no in-the-wild evidence; third-party DB restates advisory rather than auditing it

source_title: Introducing rubrics for Deep Agents
claim_summary: Vendor introduces RubricMiddleware: a grader sub-agent reviews work against a user rubric and the agent iterates until every criterion is satisfied or a cap is hit
availability: beta; API may change
limitation: Agent-graded rubrics are not independent acceptance; no version stated; no measured effect on accepted-task quality

source_title: Path traversal and sandbox escape in LangChain file-search middleware and loaders (CVE-2026-55443)
claim_summary: Medium-severity advisory: file-search middleware, prompt/config loaders and path-prefix checks did not confine resolved paths, so globs/symlinks or untrusted LLM input could disclose files outside the root; langchain up to 1.3.8 (patched 1.3.9) and langchain-anthropic up to 1.4.5 (patched 1.4.6)
limitation: Vendor states no evidence of in-the-wild triggering; impact depends on exposing tools to untrusted input

source_title: Introducing OpenWiki Brains: general-purpose wiki memory for agents
claim_summary: Vendor launches OpenWiki 0.1.0, an open-source framework that builds and maintains a local Markdown wiki memory for agents from sources such as Gmail, Notion, git repos and web search; Slack support coming soon; GitHub API reports MIT license for langchain-ai/openwiki
availability: open source v0.1.0; format expected to evolve
limitation: Early version; connecting personal mail/notes raises privacy and retention questions; no independent usage evidence

source_title: What does it mean to own your intelligence?
claim_summary: CEO essay argues companies need control over models, agent systems, context and memory, and should buy generic infrastructure but own the learning loop that compounds
availability: opinion/direction; no product availability
limitation: Commercial positioning, not evidence of customer outcomes

source_title: July 27-31, 2026 LangSmith changelog entry
claim_summary: Changelog entry deprecates legacy v1 run and sharing endpoints with a sunset date of 2027-01-31 and exposes annotation-queue item endpoints through the public API and SDK
availability: deprecation announced; removal scheduled after window
limitation: Weekly changelog has no per-entry anchor; read through a summarizing fetch tool; actual removal not yet observable

source_title: Deep Agents v0.7
claim_summary: Python and JS release removes built-in system prompt, trims builtin tool descriptions 43%, makes todos opt-in (vendor reports default-turn base input ~6k to ~2k tokens); breaking: TodoListMiddleware off by default, v0.5 backend factories removed, delete tool added to default filesystem tools
availability: released on PyPI/npm; GitHub release same day
limitation: Token reduction is vendor-measured; fewer tokens is not an energy or emissions measurement; breaking changes impose migration cost

source_title: LangSmith LLM Gateway: runtime controls for production agents
claim_summary: Vendor says gateway offers spend caps (402 on cap) and rate limits at org/workspace/key/user level, per-customer policies, model/host fallbacks, Enterprise-only PII/secret redaction; supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Fireworks and compatible endpoints; broader guardrails listed as future
availability: public beta for Plus and Enterprise plans (private beta at Interrupt)
limitation: Redaction efficacy not independently tested; plan-gated features

source_title: Namespace prefix matching crosses segment boundaries in Postgres and SQLite stores (CVE-2026-71433)
claim_summary: Medium-severity advisory: stores matched dot-joined namespaces with LIKE prefix so scoped search/list could return sibling namespaces (e.g. other tenants' memories) without crafted input; patched in checkpoint-postgres and checkpoint-sqlite 3.1.1
availability: patched 3.1.1
limitation: Vendor states no evidence of exploitation; impact depends on using namespaces as tenant boundary

source_title: Managed Deep Agents is now in public beta
claim_summary: Vendor moves Managed Deep Agents to public beta: thread state survives turns/restarts/failures, durable pause/retry/resume, agent-scoped memory under /memories/ backed by Context Hub, per-thread sandbox by default, every run traced
availability: public beta; LangSmith Cloud US region only; CLI-first while API is finalized
limitation: Plans/pricing not stated; beta interfaces may change; same product as 041-MDA rows, not a separate launch

source_title: LangSmith BYOC is now generally available on AWS
claim_summary: Vendor says Bring Your Own Cloud runs a LangChain-operated data plane (VPC, private EKS, databases, object storage, traces/datasets/prompts) in the customer AWS account with control plane in LangChain cloud over PrivateLink; 15 AWS regions
availability: GA on AWS for Enterprise customers only
limitation: Data-residency claims are vendor-stated; AWS only; no independent compliance audit located

source_title: LangGraph SDK custom auth silently ignores actions= on resource decorators (CVE-2026-104873)
claim_summary: High-severity advisory: actions= on @auth.on.threads/assistants/crons registered the handler for every action, so fallback authorization checks might not run; Python deployments using actions= affected; langgraph-sdk 0.1.45 to 0.4.3 affected, 0.4.4 patched
availability: patched 0.4.4
limitation: Exploitability depends on handler logic; no exploitation data

source_title: MCP in LangChain: stateless protocol, elicitation and more
claim_summary: Vendor says MCP support moved into langchain.mcp (extra langchain[mcp]>=1.4.0) built on FastMCP; MultiServerMCPClient collapses into MCPAdapter; supports stateless MCP spec and elicitation surfaced as a LangGraph interrupt requiring a checkpointer; Python now, TypeScript to follow
availability: langchain 1.4.0 released; MCP namespace labelled beta, API may change
limitation: Migration from langchain-mcp-adapters required; TS parity announced only

source_title: September 7-14, 2026 LangSmith changelog entry
claim_summary: Changelog entry says traces ingested into LangSmith SaaS with extended retention are kept for at most 180 days starting 2026-09-14
availability: SaaS policy change effective 2026-09-14
limitation: Whether cap applies retroactively to existing traces not verified; read through summarizing fetch tool; no per-entry anchor

source_title: LangSmith Engine v2: Red teaming and automated testing
claim_summary: Vendor adds red teaming (finds hallucinations, prompt violations), trajectory-inefficiency and trend detection, and pre-validated fixes that reproduce a failure and test a fix on LangSmith Deployment; self-hosted support and BYOK described as coming
feature: automated red teaming and fix validation
availability: red teaming and fix testing private beta for existing LangSmith Deployment users; SaaS Plus/Enterprise
limitation: Vendor-validated fixes are not independent acceptance; no false-positive/negative rates published

source_title: Trajectories now in LangSmith: a readable view of every agent session
claim_summary: Vendor describes a trajectory as a projection over the traces in a thread that aggregates messages from the main agent and subagents in first-appearance order, removing nested run structure
availability: available on all plans in the US per vendor
limitation: Same-vendor changelog is documentary corroboration, not independent check; non-US availability unstated

source_title: LangGraph JavaScript custom authentication may permit cross-user Store access
claim_summary: High-severity advisory without CVE ID at access: JS/TS custom auth Store handlers that rewrite the namespace may not be applied, letting an authenticated ordinary user access Store data outside their namespace; langgraph-api 0.1.2 to below 0.15.0 affected, 0.15.0 patched
availability: patched 0.15.0
limitation: Requires a specific JS/TS custom-auth configuration; no CVE listed at access; no exploitation data

source_title: Managed Deep Agents v0.9: schedules, per-run configuration, and Slack reactions
claim_summary: Vendor adds agent-created schedules (Schedules SDK), per-run selection of model, instructions, skills, MCP servers and sandbox, and Slack reactions; per-user memory attributed to v0.8
feature: scheduled and per-run configurable hosted agents
availability: public beta
limitation: Beta; scheduling creates unattended agent actions whose review cost is unmeasured

source_title: Unencoded identifiers in LangGraph SDK v3 streaming can redirect authenticated GET requests
claim_summary: Medium-severity advisory without CVE ID at access; langgraph-sdk 0.4.0 to below 0.4.6 (patched 0.4.6) and langgraph 1.2.3 to below 1.2.14 (patched 1.2.14) affected
limitation: Only advisory title and version ranges read; full exploit conditions not reviewed
